title: Lakshya Sen Advances to Second Round at Kumamoto Masters Japan
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen secured a crucial win to progress in an international tournament.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen defeated Chinese Taipei's Chi Yu Jen in a tough 68-minute match (21-19, 21-18) to move into the second round of the Kumamoto Masters Japan.

title: Indian Badminton League Set for Chennai Return Early Next Year
indian_angle: The potential return of the Indian Badminton League to Chennai provides a significant boost for domestic badminton and player development.
summary: The Indian Badminton League (IBL) is reportedly planning its next edition to be held in Chennai in early 2027, signaling a revival for the domestic professional circuit.

title: Indian Boxer Ambekar Meetei Storms into Youth Olympics Final
indian_angle: Ambekar Meetei's historic achievement marks India's first Youth Olympics boxing final in 16 years, showcasing the nation's rising athletic prowess.
summary: Indian boxer Ambekar Meetei secured a place in the men's 50kg final at the Youth Olympics, ending a 16-year drought for an Indian boxer in this prestigious event with a semifinal victory against his Colombian opponent.
